Name: Gift Tastes Make (More) Sense
Author: elnfl
Description:
[size=5]Features [/size][list]
[*][size=3]Adds new permanently liked/loved gifts [/size]
[*][size=3]Adds seasonal gift taste adjustments [/size]
[*][size=3]Adds story-dependent liked/loved gifts (unlocked after certain heart events) [/size]
[*][size=3]Fully configurable - can toggle between vanilla/modded preferences for each individual character and item [/size]
[/list]
[size=5]Changed Gift Tastes[/size][size=3][b] [/b][/size][size=6]
[/size][size=3][b]Abigail likes jack-o-lanterns [/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3] Secret note #1 mentions that Abigail loves the smell of carved pumpkin.[/size]
[/list][size=3][b]Abigail likes fairy stones [/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Abigail likes purple, as well as the occult. Fairy stones are purple and an old miner's song says they are made from the bones of ancient fairies (see item description). [/size]
[/list][size=3][b]Shane likes chicken statues [/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Shane likes chickens. [/size]
[/list][size=3][b]Leah likes marble [/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]The item description says marble is a very popular material for sculptures. Leah spends each morning sculpting. [/size]
[/list][size=3][b]Leah likes hardwood 
[/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3]The item description says hardwood is a "special kind of wood with superior strength and beauty", and it is a less common building material that Robin also likes as a gift. Leah uses wood for some of her art projects. Leah also likes driftwood. [/size]
[/list][size=3][b]Lewis loves blueberries during summer [/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]On summer Sundays, Lewis asks the farmer if they have any blueberries and comments that he enjoys fresh blueberries.[/size]
[/list][size=3][b]Shane likes Joja Cola after his 6-heart event [/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Shane starts cutting down on alcohol after his 6-heart event, and he has been seen drinking Joja Cola instead (see 14-heart event). He also loves Joja Cola when he is in the Movie Theater. [/size]
[/list][size=3][b]Shane hates beer after his 6-heart event [/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Shane starts cutting down on alcohol after his 6-heart event, and he has been seen actively trying to avoid alcohol. The farmer helps Shane get help for his alcoholism as well.[/size]
[/list][size=3][b]Willy likes crabs[/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3]Willy calls the player a "fellow crab enthusiast" and gives a gift if the player has filled a fish pond with 10 crabs. Willy also loves "The Art O' Crabbing" as a gift.[/size]
[/list][size=5]Config Options [/size]
[size=3]You can change the config by editing the config.json file or by using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]. [/size][list]
[*][size=3]Enable Mod: When unchecked, no gift tastes will be changed (return to vanilla preferences). [/size]
[*][size=3]Toggles for individual preferences: When unchecked, the item will revert to its vanilla preference. [/size]
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility [/size]
[size=3]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.[/size]

[size=5]Suggestions
[/size][size=3]This mod changes only a handful of preferences so far. This is because I wanted to make sure every preference change was explainable by vanilla in-game content. However, if you have any ideas or suggestions, I am more than happy to hear them! 

[/size][size=5]Credits[/size][size=3]
Thank you to stargirl for Shane's dialogue when gifted beer after his 6-heart event![/size]
